talkContent: Greetings, chosen one. The Ninja World is just a chaotic corner of the vast multiverse. All worlds are awaiting your salvation.
talkContent_vn: Chào người được chọn, Nhẫn giới chỉ là một góc hỗn loạn của vạn giới, chư thiên vạn giới đang chờ đợi sự cứu rỗi của bạn.
talkContent_ma: Salam kepada yang terpilih, Dunia Ninja hanyalah satu sudut kacau dari pelbagai dunia, seluruh alam semesta sedang menunggu penyelamatan daripada anda.
talkContent_en: Greetings, chosen one. The Ninja World is just a chaotic corner of the vast multiverse. All worlds are awaiting your salvation.
talkContent_ph: Kumusta sa napiling isa, Ang Mundo ng Ninja ay isa lamang magulong bahagi ng maraming mundo, naghihintay ang lahat ng uniberso sa iyong pagligtas.
talkContent_th: สวัสดีผู้ถูกเลือก โลกนินจาเป็นเพียงมุมหนึ่งที่วุ่นวายในบรรดาหมื่นโลก ทุกจักรวาลกำลังรอคอยการช่วยเหลือจากคุณ
talkContent_in: Salam untuk yang terpilih, Dunia Ninja hanyalah sudut kacau dari berbagai dunia, seluruh semesta menunggu penyelamatan dari kamu.

talkContent: Oh right, I am a star spirit from the cosmos, people like to call me Star Child. I am responsible for guiding you to become stronger.
talkContent_vn: À phải rồi, ta là tinh linh đến từ tinh không, mọi người thích gọi ta là Tinh Tử, ta có trách nhiệm chỉ dẫn ngươi trở nên mạnh mẽ đó nha.
talkContent_ma: Oh ya, aku adalah roh bintang dari angkasa, semua orang suka memanggilku sebagai Xing Zi, dan aku bertanggungjawab membimbingmu menjadi lebih kuat.
talkContent_en: Oh right, I am a star spirit from the cosmos, people like to call me Star Child. I am responsible for guiding you to become stronger.
talkContent_ph: Oo nga pala, ako ay isang espiritu mula sa mga bituin, tinatawag nila akong Bituin Bata, at ako ang gagabay sa’yo upang maging mas malakas.
talkContent_th: อ้อใช่ ฉันคือจิตวิญญาณแห่งดวงดาวจากจักรวาล ทุกคนชอบเรียกฉันว่า ซิงจื่อ ฉันมีหน้าที่แนะนำให้คุณแข็งแกร่งขึ้น
talkContent_in: Oh ya, aku adalah roh bintang dari luar angkasa, semua orang memanggilku Xing Zi, aku bertanggung jawab membimbingmu menjadi lebih kuat.

talkContent: You’re new here, I don’t know your name yet. Please tell me your name.
talkContent_vn: Bạn mới đến, tôi còn chưa biết bạn tên gì, cho tôi biết tên của bạn đi.
talkContent_ma: Anda baru tiba, saya masih belum tahu nama anda, beritahulah saya nama anda.
talkContent_en: You’re new here, I don’t know your name yet. Please tell me your name.
talkContent_ph: Bago ka lang dito, hindi ko pa alam ang pangalan mo. Sabihin mo naman sa akin ang pangalan mo.
talkContent_th: คุณเพิ่งมาถึง ฉันยังไม่รู้ชื่อคุณเลย บอกชื่อคุณให้ฉันรู้หน่อย
talkContent_in: Kamu baru datang, aku belum tahu siapa namamu, beri tahu aku namamu ya.

talkContent: Sounds like a great name, I can almost see the future where you bring order to the worlds.
talkContent_vn: Nghe có vẻ là một cái tên hay đấy, ta dường như thấy được tương lai chấn chỉnh lại mọi thứ của các thế giới ở ngươi.
talkContent_ma: Kedengarannya seperti nama yang bagus, aku seakan-akan melihat masa depan di mana engkau akan membetulkan segalanya di pelbagai dunia.
talkContent_en: Sounds like a great name, I can almost see the future where you bring order to the worlds.
talkContent_ph: Mukhang magandang pangalan iyan, parang nakikita ko na ang kinabukasan kung saan aayusin mo ang lahat ng mundo.
talkContent_th: ฟังดูเป็นชื่อที่ดีเลยทีเดียว ฉันดูเหมือนจะเห็นอนาคตที่คุณจะนำระเบียบกลับคืนสู่ทุกโลก
talkContent_in: Kedengarannya seperti nama yang bagus, aku bisa melihat masa depan di mana kamu akan mengatur ulang semua dunia.

talkContent: Kid, you talk too much! Hurry up and let me go!
talkContent_vn: Nhóc con, mày lắm lời quá đấy!Mau thả tao về!
talkContent_ma: Budak kecil, kau banyak cakap sangat! Cepat lepaskan aku balik!
talkContent_en: Kid, you talk too much! Hurry up and let me go!
talkContent_ph: Hoy bata, ang daldal mo! Bitawan mo na ako!
talkContent_th: ไอ้เด็กน้อย! พูดมากเกินไปแล้วนะ! ปล่อยฉันกลับไปเดี๋ยวนี้!
talkContent_in: Anak kecil, kamu cerewet banget! Cepat lepaskan aku pulang!

talkContent: Yes, very good! That’s how it should be — the chosen one should have the courage to question everything!
talkContent_vn: Ừ, rất tốt, phải như vậy, người được chọn nên có dũng khí nghi ngờ mọi thứ!
talkContent_ma: Ya, sangat bagus, memang sepatutnya begitu, orang yang terpilih harus berani untuk meragui segala-galanya!
talkContent_en: Yes, very good! That’s how it should be — the chosen one should have the courage to question everything!
talkContent_ph: Oo, magaling! Ganyan nga — ang napiling isa ay dapat may lakas ng loob na kwestyunin ang lahat!
talkContent_th: ดีมาก แบบนี้แหละ ผู้ถูกเลือกควรมีความกล้าสงสัยในทุกสิ่ง!
talkContent_in: Ya, bagus sekali! Begitulah seharusnya, yang terpilih harus punya keberanian untuk meragukan segalanya!

talkContent: However, fate is hard to resist. I believe you’re ready to save it all, so start by saving the Ninja World first!
talkContent_vn: Tuy nhiên, ý trời khó cưỡng, ta tin rằng con đã sẵn sàng cứu vãn tất cả rồi, vậy thì hãy bắt đầu bằng việc cứu lấy nhẫn giới trước đi!
talkContent_ma: Namun, kehendak langit sukar dilawan, aku percaya kau sudah bersedia untuk menyelamatkan semuanya, maka mulakanlah dengan menyelamatkan Dunia Ninja dahulu!
talkContent_en: However, fate is hard to resist. I believe you’re ready to save it all, so start by saving the Ninja World first!
talkContent_ph: Gayunpaman, ang tadhana ay mahirap labanan. Naniniwala akong handa ka nang iligtas ang lahat, kaya simulan mo muna sa pagligtas ng Mundo ng Ninja!
talkContent_th: แต่ถึงอย่างนั้น ฟ้าลิขิตยากจะขัดขืน ฉันเชื่อว่าคุณพร้อมจะกอบกู้ทุกสิ่งแล้ว งั้นเริ่มต้นด้วยการกอบกู้โลกนินจาก่อนเลย!
talkContent_in: Namun, kehendak langit sulit dilawan, aku yakin kamu sudah siap untuk menyelamatkan semuanya, jadi mulai dari menyelamatkan Dunia Ninja dulu!

talkContent: Too talkative! This is what I’ve been doing already, do you really need to say that?
talkContent_vn: Lắm lời! Cái này vốn dĩ là việc tôi đang làm, còn cần anh/chị/bạn nói à?
talkContent_ma: Banyak cakap! Ini memang kerja aku sekarang, perlu ke kau nak cakap lagi?
talkContent_en: Too talkative! This is what I’ve been doing already, do you really need to say that?
talkContent_ph: Madaldal ka! Ginagawa ko na nga ito, kailangan mo pa bang sabihin?
talkContent_th: พูดมาก! นี่มันงานของฉันอยู่แล้ว ต้องให้คุณพูดด้วยเหรอ?
talkContent_in: Bawel! Ini memang tugasku, apa masih perlu kamu bilang?

talkContent: Hmm, this chosen one seems far more spirited than expected...
talkContent_vn: Ừm, người được chọn lần này thật sự là có tinh thần chiến đấu hăng hái ngoài dự kiến nhỉ...
talkContent_ma: Hmm, orang terpilih kali ini benar-benar bersemangat juang luar jangkaan ya...
talkContent_en: Hmm, this chosen one seems far more spirited than expected...
talkContent_ph: Hmm, ang napili ngayon ay mas palaban kaysa sa inaasahan...
talkContent_th: อืม ผู้ถูกเลือกคนนี้ไฟแรงเกินความคาดหมายจริง ๆ...
talkContent_in: Hmm, yang terpilih kali ini benar-benar punya semangat juang di luar dugaan...

talkContent: Don’t be mad, look, we’re back in the Ninja World already. But... your teammates seem to have gone ahead of you.
talkContent_vn: Đừng giận nữa mà, thấy không, chúng ta không phải đã trở lại Nhẫn giới rồi sao, nhưng mà... đồng đội của ngươi hình như đã đi trước một bước rồi thì phải.
talkContent_ma: Jangan marah lagi, nampak tak, kita dah pun kembali ke Dunia Ninja, tapi… rakan sepasukanmu nampaknya telah mendahuluimu.
talkContent_en: Don’t be mad, look, we’re back in the Ninja World already. But... your teammates seem to have gone ahead of you.
talkContent_ph: Huwag ka nang magalit, ayan o, nakabalik na tayo sa Mundo ng Ninja, pero... mukhang nauna na ang mga kasama mo.
talkContent_th: อย่าโกรธเลยนะ เห็นไหม เรากลับมาโลกนินจาแล้ว แต่...ดูเหมือนว่าเพื่อนร่วมทีมของคุณจะล่วงหน้าไปก่อนแล้ว
talkContent_in: Jangan marah dong, lihat kan, kita sudah kembali ke Dunia Ninja. Tapi... sepertinya teman-temanmu sudah mendahuluimu.

talkContent: Right now, the multiverse is in chaos, everything has changed, and your current strength alone is not enough.
talkContent_vn: Hiện tại đa vũ trụ hỗn loạn, mọi thứ đã khác, chỉ dựa vào sức mạnh hiện tại của ngươi là hoàn toàn không đủ.
talkContent_ma: Kini, multiverse dalam kekacauan, semuanya sudah berubah, kekuatanmu sekarang semata-mata tidak mencukupi.
talkContent_en: Right now, the multiverse is in chaos, everything has changed, and your current strength alone is not enough.
talkContent_ph: Ngayon, magulo ang multiverse, nagbago na ang lahat, at hindi sapat ang lakas mo ngayon.
talkContent_th: ตอนนี้พหุจักรวาลปั่นป่วน ทุกอย่างเปลี่ยนไปแล้ว พลังของคุณในตอนนี้ยังไม่พอ
talkContent_in: Saat ini multiverse sedang kacau, semuanya telah berubah, kekuatanmu sekarang belum cukup.

talkContent: To save everything, we need greater power and more allies. So, click here to begin your journey of redemption.
talkContent_vn: Để cứu vãn tất cả, chúng ta cần sức mạnh lớn hơn và nhiều đồng đội hơn. Vậy thì, hãy nhấp vào đây để bắt đầu hành trình cứu chuộc của bạn.
talkContent_ma: Untuk menyelamatkan segalanya, kita perlukan kuasa yang lebih hebat dan lebih ramai rakan seperjuangan. Jadi, klik di sini untuk mulakan perjalanan penebusanmu.
talkContent_en: To save everything, we need greater power and more allies. So, click here to begin your journey of redemption.
talkContent_ph: Upang mailigtas ang lahat, kailangan natin ng mas malakas na kapangyarihan at mas maraming kakampi. Kaya, i-click ito upang simulan ang iyong paglalakbay ng pagtubos.
talkContent_th: เพื่อกอบกู้ทุกสิ่ง เราต้องการพลังที่แข็งแกร่งยิ่งขึ้น และเพื่อนร่วมทีมที่มากขึ้น งั้นคลิกที่นี่เพื่อเริ่มต้นการเดินทางของคุณ
talkContent_in: Untuk menyelamatkan semuanya, kita butuh kekuatan lebih besar dan lebih banyak teman. Jadi, klik di sini untuk memulai perjalanan penyelamatanmu.

talkContent: Although the heroes turned into zombies have significantly weakened, you can still try to recruit them to your side. In these chaotic times, don't overlook any source of power!
talkContent_vn: Tuy các anh hùng bị zombie hóa đã suy giảm sức mạnh đáng kể, nhưng vẫn có thể thử chiêu mộ họ về dưới trướng đấy nhé. Trong thời loạn lạc này, không nên bỏ lỡ bất kỳ sức mạnh nào đâu.
talkContent_ma: Walaupun para wira yang telah dijangkiti zombi telah kehilangan banyak kekuatan, anda masih boleh cuba merekrut mereka ke dalam pasukan anda. Dalam zaman huru-hara ini, jangan lepaskan sebarang kekuatan!
talkContent_en: Although the heroes turned into zombies have significantly weakened, you can still try to recruit them to your side. In these chaotic times, don't overlook any source of power!
talkContent_ph: Kahit na humina na nang husto ang mga bayani na naging zombie, maaari mo pa rin silang subukang i-recruit sa iyong panig. Sa panahon ng kaguluhan, huwag palampasin ang kahit anong lakas!
talkContent_th: แม้ว่าฮีโร่ที่กลายเป็นซอมบี้จะอ่อนแอลงมาก แต่คุณยังสามารถลองรับพวกเขาเข้าร่วมทีมได้นะ ในช่วงเวลาวุ่นวายแบบนี้ อย่ามองข้ามพลังใด ๆ เด็ดขาด!
talkContent_in: Meskipun para pahlawan yang menjadi zombie telah kehilangan banyak kekuatannya, kamu masih bisa mencoba merekrut mereka ke dalam timmu. Di masa kekacauan ini, jangan lewatkan kekuatan sekecil apa pun!

talkContent_en: Next, we will continue the adventure, but before that, I want to give you a small graduation gift!

talkContent: Clearing hard stages not only drops items, but also jewelry enhancement badges! Try upgrading your jewelry!

talkContent_en: Clearing hard stages not only drops items, but also jewelry enhancement badges! Try upgrading your jewelry!
talkContent_ph: Ang pagdaig sa mahihirap na yugto ay hindi lang naglalabas ng mga item, may mga badge din para sa pagpapalakas ng alahas! Subukan mong i-upgrade ang iyong alahas!
talkContent_th: การผ่านด่านยากไม่เพียงแต่จะได้รับไอเทมเท่านั้น แต่ยังได้รับเหรียญเพิ่มพลังเครื่องประดับด้วย! ลองอัปเกรดเครื่องประดับดูสิ!
talkContent_in: Menyelesaikan tahap sulit tidak hanya mendapatkan item, tetapi juga lencana peningkatan perhiasan! Coba tingkatkan perhiasanmu!

talkContent: Use jewelry enhancement badges obtained from hard stages to increase the quality and level cap of jewelry.

talkContent_en: Use jewelry enhancement badges obtained from hard stages to increase the quality and level cap of jewelry.
talkContent_ph: Gamitin ang mga badge ng pagpapalakas ng alahas na nakuha mula sa mahihirap na yugto para pataasin ang kalidad at limitasyon ng level ng alahas.
talkContent_th: ใช้เหรียญเพิ่มพลังเครื่องประดับที่ได้รับจากด่านยากเพื่อเพิ่มคุณภาพและขีดจำกัดระดับของเครื่องประดับ
talkContent_in: Gunakan lencana peningkatan perhiasan yang didapat dari tahap sulit untuk meningkatkan kualitas dan batas level perhiasan.

talkContent: Congratulations on unlocking the Handbook feature, let's take a look.

talkContent: Congratulations, you have successfully unlocked the collection, click here to open it.

talkContent_in: Selamat, kamu berhasil membuka koleksi, klik di sini untuk membukanya.

talkContent: In the Handbook, you can view the heroes you have collected and receive additional attribute buffs.
talkContent_vn: Trong Sổ tay, bạn có thể xem các anh hùng bạn đã thu thập được và nhận thêm các buff thuộc tính.
talkContent_ma: Dalam Buku Panduan, anda boleh melihat wira yang telah anda kumpul dan menerima buff atribut tambahan.
talkContent_en: In the Handbook, you can view the heroes you have collected and receive additional attribute buffs.
talkContent_ph: Sa Handbook, makikita mo ang mga bayani na nakolekta mo at makakakuha ka ng dagdag na attribute buffs.
talkContent_th: ในสมุดบันทึก คุณสามารถดูฮีโร่ที่คุณรวบรวมและรับบัฟเพิ่มคุณสมบัติได้เพิ่มเติม
talkContent_in: Di Buku Panduan, kamu dapat melihat pahlawan yang telah kamu kumpulkan dan mendapatkan buff atribut tambahan.

talkContent: After collecting a certain number of heroes, you can also get extra attribute points through breakthroughs.
talkContent_vn: Sau khi thu thập đủ một số lượng tướng nhất định, bạn còn có thể nhận thêm điểm cộng thuộc tính thông qua đột phá.
talkContent_ma: Selepas mengumpul sejumlah wira tertentu, anda juga boleh mendapatkan mata atribut tambahan melalui lonjakan.
talkContent_en: After collecting a certain number of heroes, you can also get extra attribute points through breakthroughs.
talkContent_ph: Pagkatapos makalikom ng sapat na bilang ng mga bayani, makakakuha ka rin ng dagdag na attribute points sa pamamagitan ng breakthrough.
talkContent_th: หลังจากรวบรวมฮีโร่ครบจำนวนหนึ่ง คุณยังสามารถรับแต้มคุณสมบัติเพิ่มผ่านการทะลุขีดจำกัด
talkContent_in: Setelah mengumpulkan sejumlah pahlawan tertentu, kamu juga bisa mendapatkan poin atribut tambahan melalui terobosan.

talkContent: Chosen One! Keep it up, collect more heroes!
talkContent_vn: Thiên Tuyển Giả! Tiếp tục cố gắng, thu thập thêm nhiều anh hùng nhé!
talkContent_ma: Yang Terpilih! Teruskan berusaha, kumpul lebih banyak wira!
talkContent_en: Chosen One! Keep it up, collect more heroes!
talkContent_ph: Pinili! Ipagpatuloy ang pagsisikap, kolektahin pa ang mga bayani!
talkContent_th: ผู้ที่ถูกเลือก! สู้ๆ ต่อไป รวบรวมฮีโร่ให้มากขึ้นนะ!
talkContent_in: Yang Terpilih! Teruslah berusaha, kumpulkan lebih banyak pahlawan!

talkContent_in: Selamat, kamu telah membuka perlengkapan super, ayo kita lihat.

talkContent: Super equipment can be upgraded to enhance effects for heroes, increasing their combat effectiveness.
talkContent_vn: Trang bị siêu phàm có thể được nâng cấp để tăng thêm hiệu ứng cho tướng, phát huy tác dụng trong chiến đấu.
talkContent_ma: Peralatan super boleh dinaik taraf untuk menambah kesan kepada wira, meningkatkan keberkesanan dalam pertarungan.
talkContent_en: Super equipment can be upgraded to enhance effects for heroes, increasing their combat effectiveness.
talkContent_ph: Ang super equipment ay pwedeng i-upgrade para mapahusay ang epekto sa mga bayani, dagdagan ang kanilang bisa sa labanan.
talkContent_th: อุปกรณ์สุดยอดสามารถอัปเกรดเพื่อเพิ่มผลของฮีโร่ เพิ่มประสิทธิภาพในการต่อสู้
talkContent_in: Perlengkapan super dapat ditingkatkan untuk menambah efek pada pahlawan, meningkatkan efektivitas bertarung.

talkContent: During your adventure, you can obtain various types of super equipment, remember to choose the right super equipment for the right heroes.
talkContent_vn: Trong cuộc phiêu lưu, bạn có thể nhận được nhiều loại trang bị siêu phàm khác nhau, hãy nhớ chọn trang bị siêu phàm phù hợp cho các anh hùng phù hợp nhé.
talkContent_ma: Semasa pengembaraan anda, anda boleh mendapat pelbagai jenis peralatan super, ingat untuk memilih peralatan super yang sesuai untuk wira yang sesuai.
talkContent_en: During your adventure, you can obtain various types of super equipment, remember to choose the right super equipment for the right heroes.
talkContent_ph: Sa iyong pakikipagsapalaran, makakakuha ka ng iba't ibang uri ng super equipment, tandaan na piliin ang tamang super equipment para sa tamang bayani.
talkContent_th: ในระหว่างการผจญภัย คุณจะได้รับอุปกรณ์สุดยอดหลายประเภท อย่าลืมเลือกอุปกรณ์ที่เหมาะสมกับฮีโร่นะ
talkContent_in: Selama petualanganmu, kamu bisa mendapatkan berbagai jenis perlengkapan super, ingatlah untuk memilih perlengkapan super yang tepat untuk pahlawan yang tepat.

talkContent_en: Upgrading skills grants experience, and when accumulated experience is full, you can upgrade privilege levels.
talkContent_ph: Ang pag-upgrade ng kasanayan ay nagbibigay ng karanasan, kapag puno ang naipon na karanasan maaari mong i-upgrade ang antas ng pribilehiyo.

talkContent: This is the ranking rewards page, you can view and claim rewards here after rank changes

talkContent: You can see the point accumulation rewards here. Whether you win or lose, you earn points by participating in challenges. When you reach a certain number of points, you will receive rewards.
talkContent_vn: Bạn có thể xem phần thưởng tích điểm ở đây. Dù thắng hay thua, bạn đều nhận được điểm khi tham gia thử thách. Khi đạt đủ số điểm nhất định, bạn sẽ nhận được phần thưởng.
talkContent_ma: Anda boleh melihat ganjaran pengumpulan mata di sini. Sama ada menang atau kalah, anda akan mendapat mata apabila menyertai cabaran. Apabila mencapai jumlah mata tertentu, anda akan menerima ganjaran.
talkContent_en: You can see the point accumulation rewards here. Whether you win or lose, you earn points by participating in challenges. When you reach a certain number of points, you will receive rewards.
talkContent_ph: Maaari mong makita ang mga gantimpala ng pag-ipon ng puntos dito. Manalo ka man o matalo, makakakuha ka ng puntos sa pagsali sa mga hamon. Kapag naabot mo ang isang tiyak na bilang ng puntos, makakatanggap ka ng mga gantimpala.
talkContent_th: คุณสามารถดูรางวัลสะสมคะแนนที่นี่ ไม่ว่าจะชนะหรือแพ้ คุณจะได้รับคะแนนเมื่อเข้าร่วมท้าทาย เมื่อสะสมคะแนนถึงจำนวนที่กำหนดจะได้รับรางวัล
talkContent_in: Anda dapat melihat hadiah pengumpulan poin di sini. Baik menang atau kalah, Anda akan mendapatkan poin saat berpartisipasi dalam tantangan. Ketika mencapai jumlah poin tertentu, Anda akan menerima hadiah.

talkContent_en: If you want to quickly find a clan, you can click Quick Join to directly join a suitable guild.
talkContent_ph: Kung gusto mong mabilis makahanap ng isang klan, maaari kang mag-click ng Quick Join upang direktang sumali sa isang angkop na guild.
talkContent_th: ถ้าต้องการหากลุ่มอย่างรวดเร็ว สามารถคลิก เข้าร่วมด่วน เพื่อเข้ากิลด์ที่เหมาะสมทันที
talkContent_in: Jika ingin cepat menemukan sebuah klan, Anda dapat klik Bergabung Cepat untuk langsung bergabung dengan guild yang sesuai.

talkContent: If you don’t have a guild or haven’t found one to join yet, you can click Create Guild to make one yourself.
talkContent_vn: Nếu hiện tại bạn chưa có công hội, hoặc chưa tìm được công hội muốn gia nhập, bạn có thể nhấn vào Tạo Công Hội để tự mình tạo một cái.
talkContent_ma: Jika anda belum mempunyai kesatuan atau belum menemui kesatuan untuk sertai, anda boleh klik Buat Kesatuan untuk mencipta sendiri.
talkContent_en: If you don’t have a guild or haven’t found one to join yet, you can click Create Guild to make one yourself.
talkContent_ph: Kung wala ka pang guild o hindi mo pa nahanap ang gustong salihan, maaari kang mag-click ng Create Guild upang gumawa ng sarili.
talkContent_th: ถ้าคุณยังไม่มีหรือยังไม่เจอกิลด์ที่ต้องการเข้าร่วม สามารถคลิก สร้างกิลด์ เพื่อสร้างขึ้นเอง
talkContent_in: Jika saat ini Anda belum memiliki guild atau belum menemukan guild untuk bergabung, Anda dapat klik Buat Guild untuk membuat sendiri.

talkContent: Welcome to the guild interface, here you can grow and develop together with like-minded friends.
talkContent_vn: Chào mừng bạn đến với giao diện công hội, tại đây, bạn có thể cùng những người bạn có cùng chí hướng phát triển và lớn mạnh.
talkContent_ma: Selamat datang ke antara muka kesatuan, di sini anda boleh berkembang dan berkembang bersama-sama rakan yang mempunyai matlamat sama.
talkContent_en: Welcome to the guild interface, here you can grow and develop together with like-minded friends.
talkContent_ph: Maligayang pagdating sa interface ng guild, dito maaari kang lumago at umunlad kasama ang mga kaibigang may parehong layunin.
talkContent_th: ยินดีต้อนรับสู่หน้ากิลด์ ที่นี่คุณสามารถเติบโตและพัฒนาไปพร้อมกับเพื่อนที่มีเป้าหมายเดียวกัน
talkContent_in: Selamat datang di antarmuka guild, di sini Anda dapat tumbuh dan berkembang bersama teman-teman yang memiliki tujuan sama.

talkContent: Here is the daily guild task information.
talkContent_vn: Ở đây có thông tin việc cần làm hàng ngày của bang hội.
talkContent_ma: Di sini ada maklumat tugas harian kesatuan.
talkContent_en: Here is the daily guild task information.
talkContent_ph: Narito ang impormasyon tungkol sa araw-araw na gawain ng guild.
talkContent_th: ที่นี่มีข้อมูลงานประจำวันที่ต้องทำของกิลด์
talkContent_in: Di sini terdapat informasi tugas harian guild.

talkContent: Click here to enter the Donation Center
talkContent_vn: Bấm vào đây để vào Trung tâm quyên góp
talkContent_ma: Klik di sini untuk masuk ke Pusat Derma
talkContent_en: Click here to enter the Donation Center
talkContent_ph: Pindutin dito para pumasok sa Sentro ng Donasyon
talkContent_th: กดที่นี่เพื่อเข้าสู่ศูนย์บริจาค
talkContent_in: Klik di sini untuk masuk ke Pusat Donasi

talkContent: Here you can view guild missions.
talkContent_vn: Ở đây có thể xem nhiệm vụ công hội.
talkContent_ma: Di sini anda boleh melihat misi kesatuan.
talkContent_en: Here you can view guild missions.
talkContent_ph: Dito maaari mong tingnan ang mga misyon ng guild.
talkContent_th: ที่นี่สามารถดูภารกิจของกิลด์ได้
talkContent_in: Di sini Anda dapat melihat misi guild.

talkContent: Click here to go to the donation page
talkContent_vn: Bấm vào đây để đến trang quyên góp
talkContent_ma: Klik di sini untuk ke halaman derma
talkContent_en: Click here to go to the donation page
talkContent_ph: Pindutin dito para pumunta sa pahina ng donasyon
talkContent_th: กดที่นี่เพื่อไปยังหน้าบริจาค
talkContent_in: Klik di sini untuk ke halaman donasi

talkContent: You can choose to spend a small amount of gold or diamonds to build the guild, while gaining guild experience and guild funds.
talkContent_vn: Bạn có thể chọn tiêu thụ một lượng nhỏ vàng hoặc kim cương để xây dựng bang hội, đồng thời nhận được kinh nghiệm bang hội và tiền bang hội.
talkContent_ma: Anda boleh memilih untuk menggunakan sejumlah kecil emas atau berlian untuk membina kesatuan, sambil menerima pengalaman dan wang kesatuan.
talkContent_en: You can choose to spend a small amount of gold or diamonds to build the guild, while gaining guild experience and guild funds.
talkContent_ph: Maaari kang pumili na gumamit ng kaunting ginto o diyamante upang itayo ang guild, kasabay ng pagkuha ng karanasan at pondo ng guild.
talkContent_th: คุณสามารถเลือกใช้ทองหรือเพชรจำนวนเล็กน้อยเพื่อสร้างกิลด์ พร้อมรับค่าประสบการณ์กิลด์และเงินกิลด์
talkContent_in: Anda dapat memilih menggunakan sejumlah kecil emas atau berlian untuk membangun guild, sekaligus mendapatkan pengalaman dan dana guild.

talkContent: Click here to enter the Red Packet page
talkContent_vn: Nhấn vào đây để vào trang lì xì
talkContent_ma: Klik di sini untuk masuk ke halaman angpao
talkContent_en: Click here to enter the Red Packet page
talkContent_ph: Pindutin dito para pumunta sa pahina ng pulang sobre
talkContent_th: กดที่นี่เพื่อเข้าสู่หน้าซองแดง
talkContent_in: Klik di sini untuk masuk ke halaman angpao

talkContent: Here are red packets the guild can receive daily, but the quantity is limited, hurry before they run out.
talkContent_vn: Ở đây có (hồng bao) mà bang hội có thể nhận mỗi ngày, nhưng số lượng có hạn, nhanh tay thì còn, chậm tay thì hết đó.
talkContent_ma: Di sini terdapat angpao yang boleh diterima oleh kesatuan setiap hari, tetapi jumlahnya terhad, cepat-cepatlah sebelum habis.
talkContent_en: Here are red packets the guild can receive daily, but the quantity is limited, hurry before they run out.
talkContent_ph: Narito ang mga pulang sobre na maaaring matanggap ng guild araw-araw, ngunit limitado ang dami, magmadali bago maubos.
talkContent_th: ที่นี่มีกล่องซองแดงที่กิลด์จะได้รับทุกวัน แต่จำนวนจำกัด รีบหน่อยก่อนหมด
talkContent_in: Di sini terdapat angpao yang bisa diterima guild setiap hari, tapi jumlahnya terbatas, cepat sebelum habis.

talkContent: Participate in building the guild, after guild upgrades the value and number of red packets can increase.
talkContent_vn: Tham gia xây dựng công hội, sau khi công hội nâng cấp có thể tăng giá trị và số lượng hồng bao nhé.
talkContent_ma: Sertai membina kesatuan, selepas kesatuan naik taraf boleh meningkatkan nilai dan jumlah angpao.
talkContent_en: Participate in building the guild, after guild upgrades the value and number of red packets can increase.
talkContent_ph: Sumali sa pagtatayo ng guild, pagkatapos ng pag-upgrade ng guild, maaaring tumaas ang halaga at bilang ng mga pulang sobre.
talkContent_th: เข้าร่วมสร้างกิลด์ หลังจากกิลด์อัปเกรดแล้วจะเพิ่มมูลค่าและจำนวนซองแดง
talkContent_in: Ikut serta membangun guild, setelah guild naik level nilai dan jumlah angpao bisa bertambah.

talkContent: Click here to view red packets sent by teammates.
talkContent_vn: Nhấn vào đây để xem lì xì do đồng đội phát.
talkContent_ma: Klik di sini untuk melihat angpao yang diedarkan oleh rakan sepasukan.
talkContent_en: Click here to view red packets sent by teammates.
talkContent_ph: Pindutin dito para tingnan ang mga pulang sobre na ipinamahagi ng mga kasamahan.
talkContent_th: กดที่นี่เพื่อดูซองแดงที่เพื่อนร่วมทีมแจก
talkContent_in: Klik di sini untuk melihat angpao yang dibagikan oleh rekan tim.

talkContent: Here are red packets you can send, sending red packets does not cost money.
talkContent_vn: Ở đây có bao lì xì bạn có thể phát, phát lì xì không tốn tiền đâu nhé.
talkContent_ma: Di sini ada angpao yang boleh anda edarkan, mengedarkan angpao tidak memerlukan wang.
talkContent_en: Here are red packets you can send, sending red packets does not cost money.
talkContent_ph: Narito ang mga pulang sobre na maaari mong ipamahagi, ang pamamahagi ng pulang sobre ay hindi gumagastos ng pera.
talkContent_th: ที่นี่มีซองแดงที่คุณสามารถแจกได้ การแจกซองแดงไม่เสียเงิน
talkContent_in: Di sini ada angpao yang bisa Anda bagikan, membagikan angpao tidak mengeluarkan biaya.

talkContent: If you don’t have any red packets to send, you can click here to learn how to get them.
talkContent_vn: Nếu bạn chưa có lì xì nào để phát, bạn có thể nhấp vào đây để xem cách nhận lì xì.
talkContent_ma: Jika anda belum ada angpao untuk diedarkan, anda boleh klik di sini untuk melihat cara mendapat angpao.
talkContent_en: If you don’t have any red packets to send, you can click here to learn how to get them.
talkContent_ph: Kung wala kang pulang sobre na maipamahagi, maaari kang pumindot dito para malaman kung paano kumuha ng mga ito.
talkContent_th: ถ้าคุณยังไม่มีซองแดงให้แจก คุณสามารถกดที่นี่เพื่อดูวิธีรับซองแดง
talkContent_in: Jika Anda belum punya angpao untuk dibagikan, Anda dapat klik di sini untuk melihat cara mendapatkannya.

talkContent: Greetings Tianxuan Heroes, the growth path has opened, you can start challenging!
talkContent_vn: Thân ái các Thiên Tuyển Giả, con đường trưởng thành đã mở ra, có thể tiến hành khiêu chiến!
talkContent_ma: Salam rakan-rakan Tianxuan, jalan pertumbuhan telah dibuka, boleh mula mencabar!
talkContent_en: Greetings Tianxuan Heroes, the growth path has opened, you can start challenging!
talkContent_ph: Pagbati mga Tianxuan bayani, bukas na ang landas ng paglago, maaari ka nang magsimulang maghamon!
talkContent_th: สวัสดีเหล่าวีรบุรุษเทียนซวน เส้นทางการเติบโตได้เปิดขึ้นแล้ว คุณสามารถเริ่มท้าทายได้!
talkContent_in: Salam para pahlawan Tianxuan, jalur pertumbuhan sudah dibuka, bisa mulai menantang!

talkContent: Please click here to enter "Adventure"
talkContent_vn: Vui lòng nhấn vào đây để vào "Phiêu lưu"
talkContent_ma: Sila klik di sini untuk masuk ke "Pengembaraan"
talkContent_en: Please click here to enter "Adventure"
talkContent_ph: Paki-click dito para pumasok sa "Pakikipagsapalaran"
talkContent_th: กรุณากดที่นี่เพื่อเข้าสู่ "ผจญภัย"
talkContent_in: Silakan klik di sini untuk masuk ke "Petualangan"

talkContent: Click here to enter "Growth Path"
talkContent_vn: Bấm vào đây để vào "Con đường trưởng thành"
talkContent_ma: Klik di sini untuk masuk ke "Jalan Pertumbuhan"
talkContent_en: Click here to enter "Growth Path"
talkContent_ph: Pindutin dito para pumasok sa "Landas ng Paglago"
talkContent_th: กดที่นี่เพื่อเข้าสู่ "เส้นทางการเติบโต"
talkContent_in: Klik di sini untuk masuk ke "Jalur Pertumbuhan"

talkContent: Displays stages that can be challenged here
talkContent_vn: Hiển thị các màn có thể thử thách tại đây
talkContent_ma: Paparkan tahap yang boleh dicabar di sini
talkContent_en: Displays stages that can be challenged here
talkContent_ph: Ipinapakita dito ang mga yugto na maaaring hamunin
talkContent_th: แสดงด่านที่สามารถท้าทายได้ที่นี่
talkContent_in: Menampilkan tahapan yang bisa ditantang di sini

talkContent: Each day you have one chance to refresh the stage, after refreshing it returns to the original stage state.
talkContent_vn: Mỗi ngày có một lần cơ hội làm mới màn chơi, sau khi làm mới sẽ về trạng thái màn chơi ban đầu.
talkContent_ma: Setiap hari ada satu peluang untuk menyegarkan tahap, selepas segar akan kembali ke keadaan asal tahap.
talkContent_en: Each day you have one chance to refresh the stage, after refreshing it returns to the original stage state.
talkContent_ph: Bawat araw may isang pagkakataon kang i-refresh ang yugto, pagkatapos mag-refresh ay babalik sa orihinal na estado ng yugto.
talkContent_th: ทุกวันมีโอกาสรีเฟรชด่าน 1 ครั้ง หลังรีเฟรชจะกลับสู่สถานะเดิมของด่าน
talkContent_in: Setiap hari Anda memiliki satu kesempatan untuk menyegarkan tahapan, setelah segar akan kembali ke kondisi awal tahapan.

talkContent: After the stage is initialized, you can use quick sweep function to skip to the current max challenge stage.
talkContent_vn: Sau khi màn chơi được khởi tạo, có thể sử dụng tính năng quét nhanh để vượt qua đến màn chơi thử thách tối đa hiện tại.
talkContent_ma: Selepas tahap dimulakan, boleh menggunakan fungsi imbas cepat untuk melewati ke tahap cabaran maksimum sekarang.
talkContent_en: After the stage is initialized, you can use quick sweep function to skip to the current max challenge stage.
talkContent_ph: Pagkatapos ma-setup ang yugto, maaari mong gamitin ang mabilis na sweep para makalaktaw sa kasalukuyang pinakamataas na yugto ng hamon.
talkContent_th: หลังจากเริ่มด่านแล้ว คุณสามารถใช้ฟังก์ชันสแกนเร็วเพื่อข้ามไปยังด่านท้าทายสูงสุดในปัจจุบัน
talkContent_in: Setelah tahapan dimulai, Anda dapat menggunakan fungsi penyapuan cepat untuk melewati ke tahapan tantangan maksimal saat ini.

talkContent: Now let’s click the first stage!
talkContent_vn: Bây giờ chúng ta hãy nhấp vào màn chơi đầu tiên nhé!
talkContent_ma: Sekarang mari klik tahap pertama!
talkContent_en: Now let’s click the first stage!
talkContent_ph: Ngayon, pindutin natin ang unang yugto!
talkContent_th: ตอนนี้มาคลิกด่านแรกกันเถอะ!
talkContent_in: Sekarang mari klik tahapan pertama!

talkContent: Jewelry draws can get star upgrade items that can greatly enhance jewelry attributes.
talkContent_vn: Rút thăm trang sức có thể nhận được đạo cụ tăng sao, có thể tăng mạnh thuộc tính trang sức.
talkContent_ma: Undian barang kemas boleh mendapat alat peningkatan bintang, boleh meningkatkan atribut barang kemas dengan ketara.
talkContent_en: Jewelry draws can get star upgrade items that can greatly enhance jewelry attributes.
talkContent_ph: Ang pag-draw ng alahas ay maaaring makakuha ng mga item na nagpapataas ng bituin, na lubos na nagpapalakas sa mga katangian ng alahas.
talkContent_th: การสุ่มเครื่องประดับสามารถได้รับไอเท็มเพิ่มดาวที่ช่วยเพิ่มคุณสมบัติของเครื่องประดับอย่างมาก
talkContent_in: Undian perhiasan dapat memperoleh item peningkatan bintang yang bisa meningkatkan atribut perhiasan secara signifikan.

talkContent: Click here to enter the draw interface.
talkContent_vn: Bấm vào đây để vào giao diện rút thăm.
talkContent_ma: Klik di sini untuk masuk ke antaramuka undian.
talkContent_en: Click here to enter the draw interface.
talkContent_ph: Pindutin dito para pumasok sa interface ng pag-draw.
talkContent_th: กดที่นี่เพื่อเข้าสู่หน้าเลือกสุ่ม
talkContent_in: Klik di sini untuk masuk ke antarmuka undian.

talkContent: Click here to open jewelry draw
talkContent_vn: Bấm vào đây để mở rút thăm trang sức
talkContent_ma: Klik di sini untuk buka undian barang kemas
talkContent_en: Click here to open jewelry draw
talkContent_ph: Pindutin dito para buksan ang pag-draw ng alahas
talkContent_th: กดที่นี่เพื่อเปิดการสุ่มเครื่องประดับ
talkContent_in: Klik di sini untuk membuka undian perhiasan

talkContent: Each day you can draw jewelry once for free, don’t forget!
talkContent_vn: Mỗi ngày đều có thể rút thăm trang sức miễn phí một lần, đừng quên nhé!
talkContent_ma: Setiap hari boleh undi barang kemas sekali secara percuma, jangan lupa ya!
talkContent_en: Each day you can draw jewelry once for free, don’t forget!
talkContent_ph: Bawat araw maaari kang mag-draw ng alahas nang libre nang isang beses, huwag kalimutan!
talkContent_th: ทุกวันสามารถสุ่มเครื่องประดับฟรีได้หนึ่งครั้ง อย่าลืมนะ!
talkContent_in: Setiap hari dapat melakukan undian perhiasan gratis sekali, jangan lupa ya!

talkContent: Congratulations on successfully activating the cultivation system, let’s take a look together.
talkContent_vn: Chúc mừng bạn đã kích hoạt thành công hệ thống tu luyện, chúng ta cùng xem qua nhé.
talkContent_ma: Tahniah anda telah berjaya mengaktifkan sistem latihan, mari kita lihat bersama.
talkContent_en: Congratulations on successfully activating the cultivation system, let’s take a look together.
talkContent_ph: Binabati kita sa matagumpay na pag-activate ng sistema ng paglinang, tingnan natin ito nang magkasama.
talkContent_th: ขอแสดงความยินดีที่คุณได้เปิดใช้งานระบบฝึกฝนสำเร็จแล้ว มาดูกันเถอะ
talkContent_in: Selamat, Anda telah berhasil mengaktifkan sistem pelatihan, mari kita lihat bersama.

talkContent: Congratulations, you have successfully activated the cultivation system, press "Nurture".
talkContent_vn: Chúc mừng bạn, đã kích hoạt thành công hệ thống tu luyện, nhấn "Bồi dưỡng".
talkContent_ma: Tahniah, anda telah berjaya mengaktifkan sistem latihan, tekan "Pemupukan".
talkContent_en: Congratulations, you have successfully activated the cultivation system, press "Nurture".
talkContent_ph: Binabati kita, matagumpay mong na-activate ang sistema ng paglinang, pindutin ang "Pagsasanay".
talkContent_th: ขอแสดงความยินดี คุณได้เปิดใช้งานระบบฝึกฝนสำเร็จแล้ว กดที่ "บำรุง"
talkContent_in: Selamat, Anda telah berhasil mengaktifkan sistem pelatihan, tekan "Pemeliharaan".

talkContent: Press "Cultivate" to enter the function control panel.
talkContent_vn: Nhấn vào "Tu luyện" để vào bảng điều khiển chức năng.
talkContent_ma: Tekan "Latihan" untuk masuk ke papan kawalan fungsi.
talkContent_en: Press "Cultivate" to enter the function control panel.
talkContent_ph: Pindutin ang "Linangin" upang pumasok sa control panel ng mga function.
talkContent_th: กดที่ "ฝึกฝน" เพื่อเข้าสู่แผงควบคุมฟังก์ชัน
talkContent_in: Tekan "Latihan" untuk masuk ke panel kontrol fungsi.

talkContent: Cultivation points can be earned during adventures, cultivation points are used to level up cultivation, helping to enhance combat abilities.
talkContent_vn: Điểm tu luyện có thể nhận được trong quá trình mạo hiểm, điểm tu luyện dùng để tăng cấp tu luyện, giúp tăng cường khả năng chiến đấu.
talkContent_ma: Mata latihan boleh diperoleh semasa pengembaraan, mata latihan digunakan untuk menaikkan tahap latihan, membantu meningkatkan keupayaan bertarung.
talkContent_en: Cultivation points can be earned during adventures, cultivation points are used to level up cultivation, helping to enhance combat abilities.
talkContent_ph: Ang mga puntos ng paglinang ay maaaring makuha habang naglalakbay, ang mga puntos ay ginagamit upang i-level up ang paglinang, na tumutulong upang mapahusay ang kakayahang makipaglaban.
talkContent_th: คะแนนฝึกฝนสามารถรับได้ระหว่างผจญภัย คะแนนฝึกฝนใช้สำหรับการอัปเลเวลการฝึกฝน ช่วยเพิ่มความสามารถในการต่อสู้
talkContent_in: Poin latihan bisa didapatkan selama petualangan, poin latihan digunakan untuk menaikkan level pelatihan, membantu meningkatkan kemampuan bertarung.

talkContent: Click here to open cultivation skills.
talkContent_vn: Nhấn vào đây để mở kỹ năng tu luyện
talkContent_ma: Tekan di sini untuk membuka kemahiran latihan.

talkContent: Tianxuan Hero can assign heroes to take on various missions, completing missions grants corresponding rewards.

talkContent_en: Each mission has a corresponding quality, the higher the quality, the better the rewards.
talkContent_ph: Ang bawat misyon ay may katumbas na kalidad, mas mataas ang kalidad mas maganda ang gantimpala.

talkContent_in: Kamu dapat memilih salah satu ilusi di antarmuka ini untuk ditantang.

talkContent: Press "Hero Today" to see today’s overview information
talkContent_vn: Nhấn vào "Anh hùng hôm nay" để xem thông tin tổng quan hôm nay
talkContent_ma: Tekan "Wira Hari Ini" untuk lihat maklumat ringkas hari ini
talkContent_en: Press "Hero Today" to see today’s overview information
talkContent_ph: Pindutin ang "Bayani Ngayon" upang makita ang pangkalahatang impormasyon ngayon
talkContent_th: กด "ฮีโร่วันนี้" เพื่อดูข้อมูลโดยรวมของวันนี้
talkContent_in: Tekan "Pahlawan Hari Ini" untuk melihat informasi ringkasan hari ini

talkContent: Displays all illusions that can be challenged today and corresponding target heroes.
talkContent_vn: Hiển thị tất cả các ảo ảnh có thể khiêu chiến hôm nay và tướng mục tiêu tương ứng.
talkContent_ma: Memaparkan semua ilusi yang boleh dicabar hari ini dan sasaran wira yang sesuai.
talkContent_en: Displays all illusions that can be challenged today and corresponding target heroes.
talkContent_ph: Ipinapakita ang lahat ng ilusyon na maaaring hamunin ngayon at ang mga target na bayani.
talkContent_th: แสดงภาพลวงตาทั้งหมดที่สามารถท้าทายในวันนี้และเป้าหมายฮีโร่ที่เกี่ยวข้อง
talkContent_in: Menampilkan semua ilusi yang bisa ditantang hari ini dan target pahlawan yang sesuai.

talkContent: Players can select illusion attribute levels based on activated heroes displayed.
talkContent_vn: Người chơi có thể chọn các cấp độ thuộc tính ảo ảnh dựa trên các tướng đã kích hoạt được hiển thị.
talkContent_ma: Pemain boleh memilih tahap atribut ilusi berdasarkan wira yang telah diaktifkan yang dipaparkan.
talkContent_en: Players can select illusion attribute levels based on activated heroes displayed.
talkContent_ph: Maaaring pumili ang mga manlalaro ng mga antas ng katangian ng ilusyon base sa mga na-activate na bayani na ipinapakita.
talkContent_th: ผู้เล่นสามารถเลือกระดับคุณสมบัติของภาพลวงตาตามฮีโร่ที่เปิดใช้งานที่แสดง
talkContent_in: Pemain dapat memilih level atribut ilusi berdasarkan pahlawan yang telah diaktifkan dan ditampilkan.

talkContent: Let’s click an illusion to challenge together!
talkContent_vn: Hãy cùng nhau nhấp vào một ảo ảnh để thử thách nhé!
talkContent_ma: Jom klik satu ilusi untuk mencabar!
talkContent_en: Let’s click an illusion to challenge together!
talkContent_ph: Tara, pindutin natin ang isang ilusyon upang hamunin!
talkContent_th: มาร่วมกดภาพลวงตาเพื่อท้าทายกันเถอะ!
talkContent_in: Ayo klik ilusi untuk menantang bersama!
